purpose: Affirm one outcome while excluding a contrasting one.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vます stem + こそすれ … negative
I feel gratitude, certainly no resentment.
The burden will increase rather than decrease.
I will support you, never obstruct you.
formation: Vます stem + こそすれ … negative
restrictions: Commonly stresses that the opposite result cannot be expected.
mistake: Use the verb stem before こそすれ.
